motivation: M8.5.2A.5 implements an owner-authorized trusted Candidate B replacement preview and active Agent task cancellation in the production macOS Launcher. The preview checks the exact fixed Runner wrapper and shows the frozen invocation before approval; cancellation is bound to the original Task, authenticated XPC connection, workspace session, and Request ID. This declaration records code review scope and is not a substitute for owner review.
invariants: No Kernel capability, approval rule, workspace scope, ABI, XPC operation, Seatbelt policy, or Runner authority changes. The existing 128-byte AgentHost scope bound is named and reused without changing accepted requests. Preview uses the exact invocation bytes approved by the user. Each Runner action still requires a separate decision. Cancellation acknowledgement is distinct from the original Kernel result; no automatic retry or claim of rollback is introduced.
authority_delta: 0 Kernel authority delta. Launcher trusted code changes only human approval presentation, frozen request validation, task-scoped cancellation, and outcome reporting; no new capability, process, IPC method, dependency, external recipient, or durable product state is added.

The focused preview and cancellation probes passed; the default signed-app Kernel XPC attack test passed without UI or Runner start. Current-tree and exact PR #38-base Security Freeze checks were rerun after this declaration update. Signed interactive acceptance remains NOT_PROVEN; no remote model was called.
